author: GamingBolt
description:
007 First Light is here. If you're looking to get the best possible start to IO Interactive’s take on James Bond’s origin story, keep these few handy tips in mind as you venture out into a globetrotting adventure where the stakes constantly rise for everybody involved. 

Thankfully, Bond is up to the task despite his inexperience and much of that success will depend on you. We've got your back, whether you're looking for ways to utilize his charismatic pursuit or unleash his more brutal side when the chips are down. You'll take on a role that lets you grow into a living legend from the comfort of your favorite chair.

Join us and make your time with Bond as special as possible.
title: 007 First Light - 20 Things It Doesn't Tell You

author: GamingBolt
description:
Few games carry a reputation for raising the bar like cult favourite action RPG series Gothic. Despite its ‘block’ graphics and sometimes impenetrable difficulty, the games ooze atmosphere and immersive exploration, breaking new ground for their pioneering style. 

There’d been calls for a remake for a few years – bringing the poorly aged aspects up to modern standards. Now, some five years-plus since announced, the Gothic 1 Remake is right around the corner. From newly accessible controls, to updated combat and branching narratives, here’s fifteen things you need to know.
title: Gothic 1 Remake - 15 Things You NEED To Know Before You Buy
